title: Restless River
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your laughter lingers in the hallway
Streetlights painting shadows on the wall

[Chorus]
The chorus carries me to you
We rise like smoke into the blue

[Verse 2]
Streetlights painting shadows on the wall
Your laughter lingers in the hallway

[Chorus]
The chorus carries me to you
We rise like smoke into the blue

[Outro]
Let the harmony remain
structure: Intro (4 bars) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Bridge (8) / Chorus (16) / Outro (4)
desc: A dark ambient song at 87 BPM in C major, written by the Signature song engine.
